name: Box Breathing without Breath Holds

instructions.description: Sit comfortably and relax the shoulders.
Inhale gently for a comfortable count.
Exhale for the same comfortable count without pausing.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record a comfortable breathing rate without prescribing a universal norm.

variations.variationDescription: Box Breathing without Breath Holds — Shorter Practice Version: Use a shorter comfortable practice period while preserving relaxed breathing.

commentsNotes: Use equal gentle inhale and exhale phases without pauses.
